summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist in monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py, exported it from monai/data/__init__.py, added a "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection to docs/source/data.rst, and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests). Nothing was run and nothing was committed. Line lengths were checked with awk (none over 120); black and flake8 were not run. Choices beyond the spec: a non-list value under the data_list_key raises ValueError, and items missing "image" or "label" are skipped rather than erroring.
